entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I ordered something and it's not right. I'm looking at my order number, it's VF... oh, this is all so confusing.
No problem at all, I can help you with that. Can you tell me what item you're calling about?
It's the Pro-Cycle jersey. I got it last week.
Okay, the Pro-Cycle jersey. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, I don't know. It's just... it's the wrong size, I think. It feels way too tight in the arms. I tried looking on the website for what to do, but it was just so many pages. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange for a different size. Let me just pull up our policy for you.
Yes, an exchange would be great. I just want one that fits properly.
I understand completely. Okay, I've checked the details. Since you received the jersey just six days ago, you are well within our 90-day return window. We can definitely process this for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. So you can do it?

Yes, absolutely. I'm going to email you a pre-paid return label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off. As soon as we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the new size you'd like. What size would work better for you?
Thank you so much, David! A Large should be perfect. You've made this so easy.
